description_en: Call AssignUsers to import one or more RAM users into a specified instance. After the import, the RAM users become agents in the instance
description_zh: 调用AssignUsers将一个或多个RAM账户导入到指定实例中，成功导入后，RAM账户将以坐席的形式存在于实例中
kebab_example: aliyun ccc assign-users --instance-id ccc-test --role-id Agent@ccc-test --skill-level-list skillGroupId_:_skillgroup@ccc-test_,_skillLevel_:5 --ram-id-list 280364111234560000_,_292343011234560000 --work-mode ON_SITE --async true --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssignUsers

parameters.description_en: The ID of the role to assign to the users in the instance. After the RAM users are imported, they are assigned this role. Valid roles are Administrator, Teamleader, and Agent.
parameters.description_zh: 角色ID，坐席导入成功后在实例中的角色，包括管理员、技能组组长和坐席三种角色。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the role to assign to the users in the instance. After the RAM users are imported, they are assigned this role. Valid roles are Administrator, Teamleader, and Agent
parameters.help_zh: 角色ID，坐席导入成功后在实例中的角色，包括管理员、技能组组长和坐席三种角色
parameters.name: role_id

parameters.description_en: A JSON array of skill objects, provided as a string. Each object specifies a skillGroupId and a skillLevel from 1 to 10. A lower skillLevel value indicates higher proficiency and greater call-handling capacity.
parameters.description_zh: 技能组的技能等级列表，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素是一个对象，包含两个字段：skillGroupId和skillLevel，skillGroupId填写坐席想要关联的技能组ID，skillLevel填写坐席在该技能组的技能等级，取值范围1-10，值越小，业务能力越强，单位时间内能处理更多的通话。
parameters.help_en: A JSON array of skill objects, provided as a string. Each object specifies a skillGroupId and a skillLevel from 1 to 10. A lower skillLevel value indicates higher proficiency and greater call-handling capacity
parameters.help_zh: 技能组的技能等级列表，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素是一个对象，包含两个字段：skillGroupId和skillLevel，skillGroupId填写坐席想要关联的技能组ID，skillLevel填写坐席在该技能组的技能等级，取值范围1-10，值越小，业务能力越强，单位时间内能处理更多的通话
parameters.name: skill_level_list

parameters.description_en: A JSON array of RAM user IDs to import, formatted as a string.
parameters.help_en: A JSON array of RAM user IDs to import, formatted as a string
parameters.name: ram_id_list

parameters.description_en: The work mode for the agents.
parameters.help_en: The work mode for the agents
parameters.name: work_mode
